issues.title: Incorrect tauri version in metadata file
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file specifies tauri version as "2.8.2" but the actual tauri crate version is "2.8.3" as shown in crates/tauri/Cargo.toml. This version mismatch will cause the CLI to report incorrect version information to tools and scripts that depend on this metadata. The PR updated the tauri version to 2.8.3, but the metadata file was not updated accordingly, creating an inconsistency between the actual library version and the advertised version.

issues.title: Dependency version mismatch for tauri-bundler
issues.description: The tauri-cli Cargo.toml declares a dependency on tauri-bundler version "2.6.0", but the actual tauri-bundler crate version is "2.6.1" as specified in crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml. This creates a version constraint mismatch that could cause build failures or prevent the CLI from using the updated bundler with the bug fix for 32-bit Windows builds. The CHANGELOG indicates this version should have been updated to 2.6.1 to pick up the binary patching fix.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14070 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes

structured_output.summary: This is an automated covector release PR. It bumps tauri to 2.8.3, tauri-bundler to 2.6.1, tauri-cli to 2.8.1 and @tauri-apps/cli to 2.8.2. It also updates the changelogs and schema `$id`s and removes the consumed change files. Most of it is consistent. The exception is `metadata-v2.json`, which still pins `tauri` to 2.8.2. The PR also includes a few changes that have nothing to do with a version bump: resolution changes for `windows-sys`/`windows-targets` in Cargo.lock and a new `homepage` field in the bundler's Cargo.toml.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The tauri version in the CLI metadata is out of sync with the release. On top of that, the lockfile and manifest edits don't belong in an automated version-bump PR.

architecture.overview: Covector reads the `.changes/*.md` files, bumps package versions, writes changelog entries and propagates dependency bumps (bundler → cli → npm cli). It also updates derived artifacts: the config schema `$id`s and `metadata-v2.json`, which the CLI uses to know which tauri version it ships with.
steps: `.changes` files describe the patch bumps for tauri and tauri-bundler.
Crate Cargo.toml versions and Cargo.lock entries get bumped.
Dependent packages (tauri-cli, @tauri-apps/cli) get bumped through dependency propagation.
Derived files get updated: the schema `$id`s and `metadata-v2.json`.
